name: Pete
storyline:
The birds in this nest include Pete's family the ones he is working the whole game to find again

Tom is Pete's older brother, the oldest bird in the nest. he is a brewers blackbird. Toms personalty is blunt, protective and harsh. He loves his siblings but as the oldest he feels a need to protect them and make sure they succeed.

Leonard is Pete's younger brother, the youngest in the nest. Leonard is a Pacific parrotlet, he is a silly bird that can not think things through and make bad decisions at times.

Arthur is also Pete's older brother. He is a Bullock's oriole, and is a very smart and thorough individual. Arthur thinks through every decision he makes, which makes him best fit for most decisions the family of birds have

Zoe is Pete's younger sister. She is a pine grosbeak, Zoe is an emotional bird she lets her brothers know how she feels when she is saddened. Zoe is a skilled builder having built most of the family's nest.
summary: In the video game Pete, you are a blue bird that has fallen out of your nest and you need to get back to your family. To do so you must find two fly orbs scattered across the map of the game, and go back to the middle of the map to fly up to your family and complete the game. Pete was developed by Craapy, and released to the public on December 23rd, 2022 for a game jam, and has seen many versions over the time of its release, including new features and fixes, the last update was on October 13th 2023.
